scientific_integrity: Contains a self-contained analytic proof and executable exact symbolic checks. Finite numerical tests supplement rather than replace the proof; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact for finite-sample Frobenius loss on quadratic black-box objectives and for the specified projector-calibrated spherical Hessian estimator; not extended to noise, nonquadratic objectives, other estimators, or all high-order perturbation limits. Potential older specialist overlap remains.
title: A sharp trace–anisotropy reversal for orthogonal directional Hessian estimates
